input_exponent_source.input: maximum absolute F32 value in a channel row

helper.domain: normal finite F32 rows and signed I32 exponent values only
helper.old_greater: scale four history words per configured stage by 2^(new-old); if exponent difference >=32, clear those words to positive zero
helper.new_greater: scan five F32 values per stage; derive per-value shifts clamped 0..60; start headroom at 32, retain minimum and subtract 6 guard; apply the helper's accepted-increase rule, rescale four history words per stage by that power of two, then store and return accepted exponent
helper.signedness: I32 comparisons and updates are signed
